navigation.notes: DSpace 7 (openYLS). Collection uuid 03845a38-2c3f-4021-82cb-27d9c650eb7a is publication-scoped: all 259 items carry dc.identifier yjhple/volN/issM/K. Content migrated from the now-dead digitalcommons.law.yale.edu/yjhple (legacy coverpage URLs preserved in dc.identifier.legacycoverpage). The registry host yaleconnect.yale.edu is a CampusGroups student-org shell with no archive and is NOT the article home. robots.txt allows /server/api with Crawl-delay: 10. WARNING: dc.date.issued on this collection is the DigitalCommons accession timestamp, not the publication date -- it is off by more than a year for 64/80 sampled items, so the adapter's `year` field is NOT trustworthy here. Derive year from volume (vol N = 2000+N) or from PDF text in the year-resolution stage. Volume/issue now come from the legacy bepress dc.identifier (yjhple/volN/issM/K) via _extract_dspace_metadata.
